description: Yesterday a big tree branch fell on my Honda Civic during the windstorm while it was parked outside my house in Mississauga. Windshield cracked and roof dented. Body shop quoted about $2,800.
Pipe burst under the kitchen sink last week, water everywhere. Cabinets and hardwood floor are ruined. Not sure on cost yet.
My car was stolen from the mall parking lot on Nov 19. It was a 2024 Toyota RAV4. I reported it to police, report #TPS-55821. I bought the policy 5 days ago.
Someone broke into my apartment on Nov 14 and took my laptop, a TV, and jewellery worth roughly $14,000 total. Police came and filed a report.
Rear-ended at a red light on Highway 7 this morning. The other driver admitted fault. My neck is sore and I'm going to see a doctor. Bumper is smashed.
